notes: The folder-path -> JSON-items string transformation from _obtain_sas_content_folder_uri, verbatim. Nested transtrn/strip idiom: transtrn(path,'/','   ') then strip then transtrn('   ','","') turns /Public/Reports/Sales into {"items": ["Public","Reports","Sales"], ...}. The Viya POST that consumes this body is excluded; the pure string builder runs stand-alone via a wrapper macro over three mock paths.
